live.title: Live Preview
live.description: Single-stream low-latency playback, detection overlay, and diagnostics
live.noPermission: This account does not have live preview permission. Ask an administrator to grant Camera Preview.
live.cameraLoadFailed: Failed to load cameras. Check the service and try again.
live.noCamera: No cameras are available. Configure a camera or change the search filter.
live.selectCamera: Select a camera from the left
live.cameraDisabled: This camera is disabled. Enable it before starting preview.
live.cameraOffline: The latest check marked this camera offline. Check the device or network first.
live.unknownHint: Unknown means no valid check result is available; it does not mean offline, so preview can still be attempted.
live.sessionFailed: Failed to create the preview session. Use the diagnostic ID to inspect Runtime and the video source.
live.stageTranscode: Connecting to the source and starting transcoding
live.stageSegment: Waiting for the first HLS segment
live.slowStartup: The video path has been starting for {0} seconds.
live.reconnectCountdown: Stream interrupted. Retrying the connection in {0} seconds
live.screenshotUnavailable: No video frame is available for capture yet.
live.overlayHint: Detections use normalized coordinates and are drawn on a separate Canvas with source aspect ratio and letterbox offsets.
live.selectReadyNode: Select an edge node with a ready preview tunnel
live.noReadyNode: No preview node is available. The node must be online and its Edge Agent preview tunnel connected.
live.eventsPending: The event path arrives in Story 9. No simulated events are shown here.
live.partialData: Only playback and the Overlay contract are available; recent events are partial data.
live.onvifDescription: ONVIF devices use their configured main or sub RTSP stream through the edge preview path.
live.rtspDescription: Standard RTSP sources enter the edge preview path directly without requiring ONVIF.
live.controlNotConfigured: The device control service is not configured, so intercom and PTZ are unavailable.
live.rtspNoIntercom: RTSP is a one-way video source and has no standard intercom control.
live.rtspNoPtz: RTSP sources do not include a standard PTZ control channel.
live.onvifControlHint: This device is registered through ONVIF. PTZ and presets can be enabled after a control service is connected.
live.rtspPlaybackOnly: RTSP playback mode supports capture, mute, fullscreen, and AI overlays.

wall.title: Split-screen Monitoring
wall.description: Drag ONVIF or RTSP cameras into independent channels with 1/4/9/16 splits and user layouts.
wall.deviceHint: Click a camera to fill the current empty cell, or drag it to a channel. Every preview channel uses the WebRTC sub stream.
wall.layoutPlanHint: Save up to 15 plans. The active plan is restored next time this page opens.
wall.layoutLoadFailed: Layout plans failed to load. The wall remains usable, but plans cannot be restored or saved.
wall.confirmOverwrite: Overwrite {0} with the current split and cameras?
wall.confirmDeleteLayout: Delete layout plan {0}? This cannot be undone.
wall.cameraAlreadyAdded: This camera is already on the wall.
wall.noEmptyChannel: There is no empty channel. Remove one or choose a larger split.
wall.emptyChannelHint: Click a camera or drag one here

recognition.syncBufferActual: This frame waited {0} ms; network jitter may change the actual wait.
recognition.syncBufferHint: Set 0–1800 ms. Lower values show more recent video; boxes are omitted when matching results have not arrived.
recognition.syncBufferSavedLocally: Applies immediately to all previews and is saved for this account in this browser. Local gateway settings are separate.
recognition.syncBufferSaveFailed: The browser could not save this setting. It applies for now but may reset after a reload.
recognition.title: Recognition capabilities
recognition.description: Tasks configured for this camera; status reflects recent heartbeats.
recognition.unavailable: Capability details unavailable. Refresh to retry.
recognition.empty: No algorithms configured. Add one in this camera’s Algorithm settings.
recognition.loadFailed: Refresh failed. Previous results retained; please retry.
recognition.staleTask: Task heartbeat expired. Recognition is unconfirmed.
recognition.analysisDescription: Boxes match this sampled frame. Updates follow the analysis frame rate.
recognition.waiting: Waiting for an analysis frame from this task
recognition.noRunning: No running recognition task on this camera and node
recognition.expired: Result expired; waiting for a new frame
recognition.noViolation: No confirmed violation in this frame; compliant and uncertain targets can be shown
recognition.unknownNote: Uncertain targets do not trigger violation alarms.
recognition.imageUnavailable: This Runtime did not provide a synchronized image. Check its version or frame size.

cameraAlgorithms.title: Algorithm settings
cameraAlgorithms.description: Manage recognition algorithms for this camera. Start, stop, or remove each configuration.
cameraAlgorithms.selection: {count} selected · Across pages, up to 100 cameras
cameraAlgorithms.removeConfirm: Remove “{algorithm}” from “{camera}”? Historical events and other cameras are kept.
cameraAlgorithms.stopBeforeRemove: Stop recognition and wait for the node to confirm before removing.
cameraAlgorithms.stoppingHint: Waiting for the node to confirm. Offline commands remain queued until reconnection; you may retry.
cameraAlgorithms.lifecycleHint: Stop keeps configuration for restarting. Remove deletes this camera’s task while preserving events and the algorithm library.
cameraAlgorithms.startSuccess: Start command submitted; awaiting node confirmation.
cameraAlgorithms.configurationHint: Reuse a task’s models, execution node, and alert rule. The source task is unchanged.
cameraAlgorithms.firstConfiguration: No existing configuration. Set up models, an execution node, and an alert rule first.
cameraAlgorithms.offlineSaveHint: The node is offline. Save now, then start after reconnection and model deployment readiness.
cameraAlgorithms.regionsHint: This configuration includes detection regions. Confirm they fit the selected camera views, or create a configuration with appropriate rules.
cameraAlgorithms.confirmRegions: I have checked that these regions fit the selected cameras
cameraAlgorithms.saveHint: Saving does not start recognition. Cameras with this algorithm keep their existing settings and state.
cameraAlgorithms.loadOrSaveFailed: Operation incomplete. Retry safely; saved configurations will not be duplicated.
cameraAlgorithms.resultHint: Start applies only to configurations created in this operation. Existing tasks keep their current state.
cameraAlgorithms.startFailed: Start failed. Configuration is kept; retry in camera algorithm settings.
cameraAlgorithms.batchWizardHint: Task names and codes are generated automatically. Each camera can be started, stopped, or removed separately.
cameraAlgorithms.capacityHint: These cameras share one execution node. Start in batches according to available node capacity.
cameraAlgorithms.modelLoadFailed: Model configuration could not be loaded. Please retry.
cameraAlgorithms.ruleLoadFailed: Could not load the alert rule. Select it again to retry.
